text.L3: A shrub has hard, woody stems that branch near the ground.
text.L4: A tree has one thick, hard, woody trunk, with branches higher up.
text.L5: So a tall banana plant is still a herb because its stem is soft.
text.L6: A young mango sapling is still a tree because it grows into one woody trunk.
text.L7: The height clue can help, but the stem is the real test.
text.L8: Now classify plants by checking the stem and the branching pattern.
